newsitem.title: SPAIN: Soros says Sterling overvalued against mark.
newsitem.headline: Soros says Sterling overvalued against mark.

text.p: International fund manager and philanthropist George Soros told Reuters on Wednesday he believed Sterling was overvalued against the German mark.
"I think the pound is overvalued, too strong, against the mark and European currencies," Soros told Reuters in an interview after presenting a cultural award in Madrid.
"I don't think the rate against the dollar is worriesome," he added.
On Wednesday, a U.K. Treasury Official said Britain's government was anxious about the pound's current high level. Sterling tested 2.90 againt the mark at midday on Wednesday
Soros reiterated he did not believe the pound would be in EMU from the start.
